races.paceDynamic: Lawmans Blis is the sole confirmed pace angle with his prominent style, giving him an uncontested lead in this 12-runner field of predominantly hold-up horses. With no genuine pace pressure, he can dictate fractions and control the race from the front, setting sustainable splits over this stamina-testing 1m6f trip. The large field of hold-up runners including Yakhabar, Angelardo, Fiftyshadesaresdev, and Bronte Beach will bunch up behind, creating traffic problems and positioning battles in the straight. This race setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging, while hold-up horses face significant tactical disadvantages.
